                # BFS
                stack = [(r,c)]
                visited[r][c] = True
                cells = []

                    cr, cc = stack.pop()
                    cells.append((cr, cc, grid[cr][cc]))
                    for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
